units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 4:10">Ter. IV, 10</cite> <he>בדורס ליטרא ק׳ וכ׳</he> if one has packed a litra of figs (of T’rumah) on top of a barrel and knows not of which; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 5:11">Tosef. ib. V, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Beitzah 3b:18">Bets. 3ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 73a:2">Zeb. 73ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Taanit 28a:7">Taan. 28ᵃ</cite>; Tosef. ib. IV (III), 7 <he>לעשות ק׳ הללו שתי וכ׳</he> to make of these figs two balls; Y. ib. IV, 68ᵇ bot.; a. e.—[<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 3:4">Maasr. III, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 21b:13">B. Mets. 21ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01821"><he>קְצִיצָה</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 1</cite> <he>משיתיר … בין ק׳ וכ׳</he> when he detaches one compartment from the other on three sides; [El. Wil. emends: <cite ref="S01821"><he>קְצִיצָה</he></cite> q. v.]—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:5:2">Y. Ned. III, 38ᵃ</cite> <he>קציעות</he>, v. <cite ref="S01793"><he>קָצוֹעַ</he></cite>.]
